schedule.title: Wedding Dinner
schedule.details: Join us for dinner, drinks, dancing, and a joyful celebration of our new beginning.

faq.question: Can I take photos?
faq.answer: YES! We encourage you to capture every special moment. However, please remember: no flash photography during the ceremony!.

faq.question: Can I bring a plus-one in your wedding?
faq.answer: Yes! Just make sure to include your plus-one in your RSVP so we can reserve seats and prepare food accordingly.

faq.question: Will transportation be provided to the venue?
faq.answer: Transportation to and from the venue will not be provided. However, ample parking spaces will be available for guests who prefer to drive.

faq.question: What if I attend the wedding without filling out the RSVP?
faq.answer: Unfortunately, if your name is not on our guest list, we won't be able to guarantee you a seat or a meal. Please make sure to complete your RSVP so we can reserve your spot and prepare enough food for everyone.

faq.question: Are children allowed at the wedding?
faq.answer: We love your little ones! Children are welcome to join the celebration. Just make sure to include them in your RSVP so we can account for their seats and meals.

faq.question: What time should I arrive for the ceremony?
faq.answer: We kindly ask that you arrive 15 minutes before the ceremony starts. This will give you plenty of time to park, find your seat, and get settled so we can begin our celebration right on time!
